borolla.name: Boyota Borolla
borolla.summary: The normal car. A dependable, affordable compact sedan with a 2.0L gas engine and room for five.
borolla.tagline: The car you forget about — because it just keeps going. A simple 2.0L engine, room for five, and nothing you don't need.
borolla.colors: Ember Red, Glacier White, Graphite, Harbor Blue
borolla.features.Gas, and nothing to learn: A 2.0L engine and a smooth automatic. Fill up, drive, repeat. No plugs, no new habits.
borolla.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Lane keeping, pre-collision braking and adaptive cruise come standard on every trim.
borolla.features.A screen that stays out of the: A touchscreen with wireless phone mirroring, and real buttons for the climate.
borolla.sections.What it costs to own: 3 yr / 36,000 mi basic warranty, 5 yr / 60,000 mi powertrain warranty, 10k miles between services (est.), 2 yr roadside assistance. Cheap to buy, cheap to keep.

bauris.name: Boyota Bauris
bauris.summary: The Bauris hybrid liftback. Pulls away on electric, recharges as you brake. Plug-in on Limited.
bauris.tagline: Fewer stops for fuel, more room for the rest. A slippery liftback that pulls away on electric and recharges as you brake.
bauris.colors: Lane Teal, Glacier White, Graphite, Fjord Blue
bauris.features.Hybrid as standard: Every Bauris pairs a petrol engine with an electric motor. No settings to learn. It just uses less.
bauris.features.Plug in if you want: Limited adds a bigger battery and a charge port. Most daily drives can run on electric alone.
bauris.features.Shaped for the wind: A long, low roof and a cut-off tail let air slip past. That means less noise and fewer stops for fuel.
bauris.sections.How the hybrid works: Pulls away on electric in slow traffic, the petrol engine joins in when merging or climbing, and braking recharges the battery with no cable needed. Limited adds a plug-in battery for up to 44 miles on electric alone (est.).

bupra.name: Boyota Bupra
bupra.summary: The Boyota Bupra: a light, rear-drive 2-door sports coupe with launch control and a 6-speed manual.
bupra.tagline: Low, light and rear-wheel drive. Built for the long way home.
bupra.colors: Ember Red, Track Orange, Graphite, Frost White
bupra.features.Turbo straight-six: A 3.0-liter inline-six with a flat torque curve. Pulls hard from low revs to the limiter.
bupra.features.Balanced chassis: Front-engine, rear-drive, near 50:50 weight split. Adaptive dampers and a limited-slip differential.
bupra.features.Track ready: Big brakes, a cooling package and a built-in lap timer. Drive to the circuit, drive home.
bupra.sections.Track mode: One button for the circuit: launch control, sharper throttle, firmer dampers, looser stability control and a lap timer.
bupra.sections.Transmission: 6-speed manual with auto rev-matching (0–60 mph 4.1 s est.) or 8-speed automatic with paddles (0–60 mph 3.9 s est.).

bamry.name: Boyota Bamry
bamry.summary: The grown-up sedan. A roomy midsize four-door with a quiet 2.5L engine, a big trunk and space for five on long drives.
bamry.tagline: More room, more quiet, more road. A 2.5L engine, a long wheelbase and a back seat adults actually like.
bamry.colors: Midnight Navy, Pearl White, Dusk Bronze, Slate Silver
bamry.features.A back seat for grown-ups: A longer wheelbase means real legroom in the rear. Three adults, three hours, no complaints.
bamry.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Lane keeping, pre-collision braking and adaptive cruise come standard on every trim.
bamry.features.Quiet at speed: Acoustic glass and extra insulation keep the highway hum down. The 2.5L does the rest without fuss.
bamry.sections.Room in the back: 38.0 in rear legroom, 15.1 cu ft trunk, 60/40 split-folding rear seat, rear vents and USB-C on every trim. Built for passengers, not just the driver.

bav4.name: Boyota BAV4
bav4.summary: The do-everything SUV. A compact crossover with all-wheel drive, a raised seat and a big flat cargo floor, sized for the city.
bav4.tagline: Sits up high, parks small. All-wheel drive, a wide cargo floor and enough clearance for the dirt road to the cabin.
bav4.colors: Moss Green, Frost White, Lava Orange, Iron Grey
bav4.features.All-wheel drive that thinks ahe: Sends power to the rear before the front slips. Snow, gravel and wet boat ramps stop being a question.
bav4.features.A cargo floor that works: Wide, flat and low, with tie-downs and a two-level floor. Bikes, dogs and flat-pack furniture all fit.
bav4.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Lane keeping, pre-collision braking and adaptive cruise come standard on every trim.
bav4.sections.What fits in the back: 37.6 cu ft behind the rear seats, 69.8 cu ft folded, two-level cargo floor, 1,500 lb towing (est.) and roof rails from XLE up.

bighlander.name: Boyota Bighlander
bighlander.summary: The family SUV. Three rows, seats for eight, a turbo 2.4L engine and room for the whole school run plus the groceries.
bighlander.tagline: Everyone fits. Three real rows, eight seats, and a third row you can reach without folding yourself in half.
bighlander.colors: Deep Ocean, Desert Sand, Alpine White, Obsidian
bighlander.features.A third row for people: Second-row seats slide and tip with one hand. The back row has its own vents, cupholders and USB-C.
bighlander.features.Keep an eye on the back: A camera view of the rear rows on the main screen, so you can see who started it without turning around.
bighlander.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Lane keeping, pre-collision braking and adaptive cruise come standard on every trim, plus a rear-seat reminder.
bighlander.sections.Every row, explained: Eight seats on LE or seven with captain's chairs, one-touch tip-and-slide to the third row, 16.0 cu ft behind row three, 84.3 cu ft with both rows folded, 5,000 lb towing.

bacoma.name: Boyota Bacoma
bacoma.summary: The Boyota Bacoma: a midsize pickup with a 5-foot bed, 4x4 on every trim but one, and room to tow a small boat.
bacoma.tagline: A truck that fits in the garage. A 5-foot bed, real four-wheel drive, and enough pull for the boat or the bikes.
bacoma.colors: Canyon Orange, Sagebrush, Basalt, Chalk White
bacoma.features.A bed that earns its keep: A composite bed that won't dent or rust, adjustable tie-downs, and a 120V outlet for tools or a fridge.
bacoma.features.Four-wheel drive that means it: Part-time 4x4 with low range and a locking rear differential. Crawl control on the Trail.
bacoma.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Pre-collision braking, adaptive cruise and trailer sway control come standard on every trim.
bacoma.sections.What fits in the bed: 5.0 ft bed, 1,710 lb max payload (est.), composite liner, adjustable tie-downs, 120V outlet. Fits two mountain bikes or a stack of plywood with the tailgate down.

bundra.name: Boyota Bundra
bundra.summary: The Boyota Bundra: a full-size crew cab pickup with a twin-turbo V6 that tows up to 12,000 lb.
bundra.tagline: Hitch it and forget it's there. A twin-turbo V6, a crew cab for five, and up to 12,000 pounds behind you.
bundra.colors: Ironwood, Midnight Steel, Summit White, Brick Red
bundra.features.Twin-turbo V6: A 3.4L twin-turbo V6 with a 10-speed automatic. Full torque low in the revs, where a trailer needs it.
bundra.features.See the whole trailer: A 14-inch screen with trailer-view cameras, a hitch guide and blind-spot coverage that stretches to the trailer's length.
bundra.features.Tow package, standard: Factory hitch, integrated brake controller, 7-pin wiring and a transmission cooler on every trim.
bundra.sections.Towing, made easy: Up to 12,000 lb (est.) on the Summit. Integrated brake controller, trailer-view cameras, hitch guide, trailer sway control and a tow/haul mode that holds gears on grades.

bienna.name: Boyota Bienna
bienna.summary: The Boyota Bienna: an eight-seat minivan with power sliding doors, a flat cargo floor and 36 mpg.
bienna.tagline: Room for eight, and the doors open themselves. The easiest way to move a family, its gear, and the friends who came along.
bienna.colors: Slate Blue, Pearl White, Moss Green, Cocoa
bienna.features.Seats that slide, fold and vani: Second-row seats slide 25 inches. The third row folds flat into the floor with one pull.
bienna.features.36 mpg, without trying: A 2.5L hybrid comes standard. No plug, no new habits, and fewer stops on the road trip.
bienna.features.Eyes on the back row: A ceiling camera shows the back seats on the main screen, and a cabin mic carries your voice to row three.
bienna.sections.Living with eight seats: Third row folds flat into the floor, second row slides 25 in, 101 cu ft cargo with seats folded (est.), 16 cupholders, USB-C at every seat, hands-free power sliding doors.

b4runner.name: Boyota B4Runner
b4runner.summary: The Boyota B4Runner: a body-on-frame, 4x4 SUV with locking differentials, real ground clearance and room for five.
b4runner.tagline: A ladder frame, a low-range transfer case and a rear window that rolls down. Built for where the pavement ends.
b4runner.colors: Canyon Clay, Lichen Green, Basalt Black, Salt Flat White
b4runner.features.Body-on-frame, on purpose: A fully boxed ladder frame and a solid rear axle. It takes the rocks, the ruts and the years.
b4runner.features.Low range when you need it: Part-time 4WD with a two-speed transfer case, crawl control and a locking rear differential.
b4runner.features.Steel underneath: Skid plates for the engine, transfer case and fuel tank. Rock rails on TRAIL and up.
b4runner.sections.Trail numbers: Approach angle up to 35° (est.), departure angle 26° (est.), 10.2 in ground clearance on BRO (est.), 32.6 in water fording depth. Solid rear axle with a locking differential.

bandcruiser.name: Boyota Band Cruiser
bandcruiser.summary: The Boyota Band Cruiser: a full-time 4WD luxury overlander with a twin-turbo V6, leather inside and the range to cross a continent.
bandcruiser.tagline: Leather seats, a fridge in the console and a fuel tank for the long empty stretches. Go anywhere, arrive rested.
bandcruiser.colors: Dune Beige, Savanna Olive, Midnight Slate, Desert Pearl
bandcruiser.features.Range for the empty map: A 3.5L twin-turbo V6 and a long-range tank on EXPEDITION. Up to 780 miles between fuel stops (est.).
bandcruiser.features.A lounge on stilts: Ventilated leather, a cooled center console and a cabin quiet enough to talk at 70 mph on gravel.
bandcruiser.features.Terrain you can see: Multi-terrain cameras show what's under the front wheels. Pick sand, mud or rock and it sets the rest.
bandcruiser.sections.Overland kit: EXPEDITION adds a hard-shell roof tent, raised snorkel, dual-battery system with 120V outlets, a console fridge and a 36-gallon long-range tank (780 mi range est.).

bequoia.name: Boyota Bequoia
bequoia.summary: The Boyota Bequoia: a full-size SUV with three real rows, eight seats and a hybrid V6 that tows a boat.
bequoia.tagline: Eight seats, a third row grown-ups can sit in and room for everyone's luggage behind it.
bequoia.features.A third row for adults: Sliding second row, a power-folding third row and real legroom in the back. Eight seats on SR5 and LIMITED.
bequoia.features.Hybrid V6 torque: A twin-turbo V6 with an electric motor in the transmission. 583 lb-ft for merging, climbing and towing (est.).
bequoia.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Pre-collision braking, blind-spot monitoring and a trailer-aware rear camera come standard.
bequoia.sections.Three rows, measured: Third-row legroom 34.3 in (est.), 22.3 cu ft behind the third row, 86.9 cu ft with both rows folded (est.). Sliding second row with one-touch access to the back.

bavalon.name: Boyota Bavalon
bavalon.summary: The quiet one. A full-size comfort sedan with a smooth V6, a soft ride and limousine legroom in the back.
bavalon.tagline: A long wheelbase, a hushed cabin and a ride that irons out the road. Five adults, no one asking how much longer.
bavalon.colors: Midnight Sapphire, Pearl Ivory, Pewter Mist, Bordeaux
bavalon.features.A back seat worth riding in: Rear legroom you can cross your legs in, heated outboard seats and a reclining rear bench on Limited.
bavalon.features.A V6 that never raises its voic: 301 hp delivered quietly through an 8-speed automatic. Acoustic glass keeps the highway outside.
bavalon.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Adaptive cruise with stop-and-go, blind-spot alert and pre-collision braking on every trim.
bavalon.sections.The quiet cabin: Acoustic laminated front and side glass, active noise cancellation through the audio system, and extra sound deadening in the floor and wheel wells. Rear seats recline on Limited.

byaris.name: Boyota Byaris
byaris.summary: The small one. A subcompact city hatch with a tight turning circle, a frugal 1.5L engine and room for four.
byaris.tagline: Short enough for any parking spot, tall enough to sit up straight. Made for narrow streets and quick errands.
byaris.colors: Citrus Yellow, Mint Tram, Chalk White, Asphalt Grey
byaris.features.Parks where others circle: 153 inches long with a 31.5 ft turning circle. Parallel park in one go, U-turn on a side street.
byaris.features.Sips, doesn't gulp: A 1.5L three-cylinder and a CVT. Around 40 mpg, and a small tank that's cheap to fill.
byaris.features.Your phone, on the dash: An 8-inch touchscreen with wireless phone mirroring, and a rear camera on every trim.
byaris.sections.Small outside, sensible inside: Seats four adults or five in a pinch, 60/40 split-folding rear seats, 13.4 cu ft of cargo space behind them and a flat floor when folded. Fits in a compact parking space with room to open the doors.

brown.name: Boyota Brown
brown.summary: The flagship sedan, raised. An executive four-door with extra ground clearance, standard all-wheel drive and a hybrid powertrain.
brown.tagline: Sedan manners, a higher seat and all-wheel drive. Arrive composed, whatever the driveway looks like.
brown.colors: Obsidian, Oxford Bronze, Platinum Silver, Deep Forest
brown.features.A higher, easier seat: The hip point sits nearly four inches above a regular sedan. Step in, not down.
brown.features.Hybrid, and all-wheel drive: A 2.5L hybrid with a rear electric motor on every trim. Platinum adds a 2.4L turbo hybrid with 340 hp.
brown.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Adaptive cruise, lane centering, and a 360° camera to watch the curbs on 21-inch wheels.
brown.sections.Executive rear seat: 38 in of rear legroom, rear climate controls, heated rear seats on Platinum, and a panoramic glass roof on Limited and up. Hands-free trunk with 15.2 cu ft of space.

bhr.name: Boyota B-HR
bhr.summary: The small crossover with a loud face. A city-sized hybrid with a coupe roofline, a two-tone roof and room for five.
bhr.tagline: Small enough for any parking spot, odd enough to find again. A hybrid crossover that refuses to look like everything else.
bhr.colors: Citrus Pop, Lagoon Teal, Chalk White, Ember Red
bhr.features.Hybrid, no plug: A 1.8L hybrid that charges itself while you brake. Most city trips use barely any fuel.
bhr.features.Park it anywhere: Short overhangs and a tight turning circle. Squeezes into gaps the bigger crossovers drive past.
bhr.features.Pick your roof: Every color comes with a contrast roof at no extra cost. Black, white or matching, your call.
bhr.sections.Make it yours: Two-tone roof in black, white or body color at no extra cost, colored interior trim inserts, and a dealer accessory kit with roof bars and bike mounts.

benza.name: Boyota Benza
benza.summary: The long, low crossover. A hybrid wagon-crossover with standard all-wheel drive, a quiet cabin and a big flat cargo floor.
benza.tagline: The comfort of a wagon, the ride height of a crossover. All-wheel-drive hybrid, standard, with space for the long weekend.
benza.colors: Moss Grey, Dune Beige, Midnight Navy, Pearl White
benza.features.Hybrid AWD, standard: A 2.5L hybrid with an electric motor on the rear axle. Grip in the rain, near 40 mpg on the highway.
benza.features.A cabin that stays quiet: Acoustic glass, thick door seals and reclining rear seats. Long drives feel shorter.
benza.features.A floor you can use: Rear seats fold flat with one pull. Low load lip, under-floor bins and a power tailgate.
benza.sections.Cargo, measured: 28.8 cu ft behind the rear seats, 55 cu ft folded flat, 1,500 lb tow rating, power tailgate with kick sensor on XLE and Limited.

birai.name: Boyota Birai
birai.summary: The hydrogen car. A fuel cell sedan that refuels in five minutes, drives like an EV and leaves only water behind.
birai.tagline: Fill up in five minutes, drive on electricity, and leave nothing behind but a little water. The quietest way across town.
birai.colors: Vapor Silver, Deep Sea Blue, Obsidian
birai.features.Drives like an EV: A fuel cell turns hydrogen into electricity for a rear motor. Silent, smooth, instant pull.
birai.features.No waiting to charge: Three carbon-fiber tanks fill at the pump in about five minutes. Over 400 miles on a full fill.
birai.features.Water is the only exhaust: No tailpipe emissions. A button on the dash lets you drain the water before you park indoors.
birai.sections.Where to fill up: Hydrogen stations are limited to a few regions, mostly California. Sample offer: up to $15,000 of hydrogen over 6 years, plus loaner cars for long trips.

bilux.name: Boyota Bilux
bilux.summary: The Boyota Bilux: a body-on-frame work ute with a 2.8L turbo diesel, a one-ton payload and a steel bed built for the farm.
bilux.tagline: Built to be used, not admired. A 2.8L diesel, a one-ton payload and a steel bed that shrugs off fence posts, feed bags and gravel.
bilux.colors: Paddock White, Red Dirt, Gum Leaf Green, Bitumen Grey
bilux.trims.SR.blurb: Four-wheel drive, ready for the back paddock
bilux.trims.SR5.blurb: Work all week, drive to town on Sunday
bilux.features.Easy to fix, hard to break: A ladder frame, leaf springs and a diesel you can service in a shed. Parts at every Boyota dealer.
bilux.features.Low-range four-wheel drive: Part-time 4WD with a locking rear differential. Wet grass, creek crossings and steep tracks are just Tuesday.
bilux.features.A cab you can hose out: Vinyl floors, wipe-clean seats and big knobs you can turn with gloves on.
bilux.sections.Tray or tub: Choose a steel tub with tie-down rails, or a flat aluminum tray with drop sides for pallets, hay bales and fencing gear. Both carry the full payload.

biace.name: Boyota Biace
biace.summary: The Boyota Biace: a high-roof van with a 2.8L diesel, as a cargo van for deliveries or with seats for up to twelve.
biace.tagline: A big box on wheels, and that's the point. Haul tools and parcels all week, or move a whole team at once.
biace.colors: Fleet White, Signal Silver, Courier Blue, Charcoal
biace.trims.Cargo.blurb: Two seats and a lot of floor
biace.trims.Crew.blurb: Five seats, still a load bay
biace.trims.Commuter.blurb: Twelve seats, sliding doors both sides
biace.features.A load bay that works: A flat floor, twelve tie-down points and a rear door that swings 270° so a forklift can get close.
biace.features.Boyota Guard 3.0, for big vehic: Pre-collision braking, blind-spot warning along the whole length and a crosswind assist for open roads.
biace.features.Fleet-ready dash: A touchscreen with phone mirroring, a built-in fleet tracker and a phone shelf where you can see it.
biace.sections.Fit it out your way: Factory shelving, roof racks, a ladder rack and a refrigerated box are available on the Cargo. Upfitter-ready wiring comes standard.

bentury.name: Boyota Bentury
bentury.summary: The Boyota Bentury: a long-wheelbase chauffeur limousine with a quiet 5.0L V8 hybrid and a rear seat that reclines flat.
bentury.tagline: Made for the back seat. A whisper-quiet V8 hybrid, a reclining rear lounge and a ride so calm you can sign papers on the way.
bentury.colors: Kamui Black, Moonlit Pearl, Eternal Silver, Deep Bordeaux
bentury.trims.Executive.blurb: Four seats, all of them good
bentury.features.A rear seat that reclines flat: Heated, cooled and massaging, with a fold-out footrest. The front passenger seat slides forward at a touch.
bentury.features.A V8 you won't hear: A 5.0L V8 hybrid pulls away on electric power alone. Air suspension reads the road ahead and smooths it out.
bentury.features.Control from the rear: A rear touchpanel runs the climate, blinds, audio and seats. A desk folds out of the center console.
bentury.sections.Chauffeur package: A driver's display that shows the rear passenger's settings, a quiet-mode button that softens braking and shifts, and a door-close system that seals every door gently.

belica.name: Boyota Belica
belica.summary: The Boyota Belica: a retro three-door hatch coupe with a lift-up glass hatch, a 2.0L engine and room for four.
belica.tagline: A seventies shape with today's manners. Long doors, a big glass hatch, and a back seat that's actually usable.
belica.colors: Marigold, Avocado, Cream Soda, Rust Brown
belica.features.Analog-look gauges: Two round dials behind the wheel, drawn on a screen. Switch to a modern layout with one button.
belica.features.Seats for four, hatch for the r: The rear seats fold flat and the glass hatch lifts high. A bike fits with the front wheel off.
belica.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Pre-collision braking, lane keeping and adaptive cruise on every trim. The retro stops at the styling.
belica.sections.Heritage details: Side stripes on GT, louvered rear quarter windows, slotted wheels and plaid cloth seats. Every piece is optional to delete.

br2.name: Boyota BR2
br2.summary: The Boyota BR2: a light two-seat roadster with the engine behind the seats and a soft top that folds in 12 seconds.
br2.tagline: Two seats, no roof, engine right behind you. The shortest way to a good mood.
br2.colors: Signal Yellow, Racing Green, Ember Red, Silverstone
br2.features.Mid-engine layout: A 1.8L turbo four behind the seats. Low polar inertia, so the car turns the moment you do.
br2.features.Light on purpose: An aluminum tub and a fabric roof keep the base car under 2,500 lb. No big screen, no extra motors.
br2.features.Roof down at a red light: The soft top folds in 12 seconds at up to 30 mph. Two small trunks, front and back, take a weekend bag each.
br2.sections.Two trunks: 4.9 cu ft up front and 5.3 cu ft behind the engine (est.). Enough for two soft weekend bags; the roof never eats into either.

bressida.name: Boyota Bressida
bressida.summary: The Boyota Bressida: a classic rear-wheel-drive sedan with a long hood, a smooth inline-six and room for five.
bressida.tagline: Long hood, upright cabin, power to the back wheels. The sedan the way it used to be done, done properly.
bressida.colors: Midnight Navy, Champagne, Oxblood, Pearl White
bressida.trims.GS.blurb: A twin-turbo for the long way
bressida.features.Inline-six, front to back: A 3.0L straight-six sits behind the front axle and drives the rear wheels through an 8-speed automatic.
bressida.features.A back seat for adults: A long wheelbase and a flat floor. Three across the back, and 15.2 cu ft of trunk behind them.
bressida.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Pre-collision braking, lane keeping and adaptive cruise on every trim, plus a rear-drive-tuned stability system.
bressida.sections.Why rear-wheel drive: Front wheels steer, rear wheels push. Cleaner steering feel, a tighter turning circle and a balanced 51:49 weight split (est.).

bjcruiser.name: Boyota BJ Cruiser
bjcruiser.summary: A boxy, retro two-row 4x4 with a 4.0L V6, low-range transfer case and a locking rear differential.
bjcruiser.tagline: Flat glass, round lights and a real low range. It looks like 1975 and climbs like it means it.
bjcruiser.colors: Sandstone Beige, Trail Blue, Moss Green, Chalk White
bjcruiser.features.Simple enough to fix on the tra: A naturally aspirated V6, a solid rear axle and bolt-on fenders. Parts you can reach, with tools you already own.
bjcruiser.features.Real low range: A two-speed transfer case and a locking rear differential come standard from the Trail trim up.
bjcruiser.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Pre-collision braking and adaptive cruise for the drive to the trailhead. Switch them off once you're there.
bjcruiser.sections.Built to be kept: Body-on-frame with a galvanized ladder chassis, bolt-on body panels, washable rubber floors on Base, 5,000 lb towing (est.). Meant to run for decades, not lease cycles.

batrix.name: Boyota Batrix
batrix.summary: A tall five-door wagon with a flat load floor, fold-flat seats and 68 cu ft of space for bikes, boards and gear.
batrix.tagline: A square back, a low floor and seats that fold flat. If it fits through the door, it fits in the Batrix.
batrix.colors: Basalt Grey, Spruce Green, Signal Orange, Salt White
batrix.features.Seats that fold flat, one hand: Pull a strap and the 60/40 rear seats drop flush with the floor. Front passenger seat folds too, for 9-foot boards.
batrix.features.Tie it down anywhere: Eight floor anchors, a wipe-clean cargo liner and roof rails rated for 165 lb of bikes, boxes or a tent.
batrix.features.Light on fuel, even loaded: A 2.0L engine with a smooth CVT, and available all-wheel drive for the gravel road to the campsite.
batrix.sections.What fits in the back: Two mountain bikes with front wheels on, a 9 ft surfboard with the passenger seat folded, or a full camping kit for four. 41.5 in wide between the wheel wells, 39 in tall tailgate opening.

becho.name: Boyota Becho
becho.summary: The lowest-priced Boyota. A small three-cylinder hatchback with four doors, low insurance and almost nothing to go wrong.
becho.tagline: Four doors, four seats and a price that starts with a one. Everything a car has to do, and not a dollar more.
becho.colors: Paper White, Pebble Grey, Tomato Red
becho.features.Small engine, small bills: A 1.2L three-cylinder that sips regular gas. Smaller tires, cheaper brakes and one of the lowest insurance groups we sell.
becho.features.Safety isn't an option: Six airbags, pre-collision braking and lane departure warning on every Becho, including the cheapest one.
becho.features.Service in an hour: Oil every 10,000 miles, a timing chain instead of a belt, and parts priced like it's still 2010.
becho.sections.What it costs to run: About $6.50 a day in fuel at 40 mpg for a 30-mile round trip (est.), 3 yr / 36,000 mi warranty, 5 yr / 60,000 mi powertrain, 10k miles between services. The cheapest Boyota to buy and to keep.

balphard.name: Boyota Balphard
balphard.summary: The first-class cabin on wheels. A tall, quiet luxury van with reclining second-row lounge seats and a 2.5L hybrid.
balphard.tagline: The back seat is the best seat. Two reclining lounge chairs, a hushed cabin and a ride that lets you sleep through the city.
balphard.colors: Opal Pearl, Obsidian Black, Champagne Mist, Midnight Navy
balphard.features.Lounge seats that lie back: Power ottomans, heating, cooling and massage. The second row reclines nearly flat at the press of a button.
balphard.features.A ceiling screen and a quiet ro: A 14-inch rear display folds down from the roof. Laminated glass and thick insulation keep the road outside.
balphard.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Pre-collision braking, lane centering and a 360° camera come standard. The driver works less, too.
balphard.sections.A cabin you can work in: Fold-out tables, wireless charging at every seat, a rear climate zone, privacy shades and a quiet-call mode that dims the audio up front.

baseo.name: Boyota Baseo
baseo.summary: Open air for the price of a hatchback. A small, light two-seat convertible with a manual soft top and a 1.5L engine.
baseo.tagline: Pull the latch, push the top back, go. A small car, a small price and the whole sky for a roof.
baseo.colors: Sunny Yellow, Coral Pop, Seafoam Mint, Chalk White
baseo.features.A top you can work with one han: One latch, one push. The fabric top folds behind the seats in eight seconds, no buttons needed.
baseo.features.Light, so it's lively: Under 2,200 lb with a 1.5L engine. It doesn't need much power to feel quick around town.
baseo.features.Roll hoops and Boyota Guard: Fixed roll hoops behind each seat, plus pre-collision braking and lane departure warning on every trim.
baseo.sections.Living with the top down: 6.2 cu ft trunk that stays the same top up or down, a wind deflector on the Club trim, and a fabric top rated for drive-through car washes.

bercel.name: Boyota Bercel
bercel.summary: No gas, ever. A fully battery-powered compact crossover with up to 310 miles of range and fast charging.
bercel.tagline: Plug in at night, wake up full. A compact crossover with no tailpipe, a flat floor and range for the whole week.
bercel.colors: Volt Teal, Cloud Grey, Night Slate, Ice White
bercel.features.Charge at home or on the road: A home wall charger fills it overnight. On a trip, a fast charger gets you from 10 to 80% in under half an hour.
bercel.features.Instant, silent pull: Full torque from a standstill and nothing to shift. One-pedal driving lets you slow down just by lifting off.
bercel.features.Route planning that knows the c: The navigation adds charging stops for you and warms the battery on the way, so every stop is quick.
bercel.compare.Extras.Dual Motor AWD: Heat pump, glass roof, tow hitch
bercel.sections.Charging and battery: Level 2 home charging in about 7.5 hours, 150 kW DC fast charging, 8 yr / 100,000 mi battery warranty, and two years of free public charging.
